verdict.rationale: Snowflake's Snowsight Query History lets you monitor queries from the last 14 days and "explore each step of an executed query in the query profile." That covers the core of diagnosing why a query is slow. However, the evidence never documents pre-execution plans (EXPLAIN) or per-query cost breakdowns. One community comment also says Snowflake lacks query-level cost attribution, so diagnosing why a query is expensive is unproven. Missing for 10: documented execution-plan/EXPLAIN inspection, per-query cost attribution in the profile, in-depth profile operator/statistics docs, independent hands-on corroboration of query-profile diagnosis.

support.subject: As a data-engineer, I can inspect query profiles and execution plans to find why a query is slow or expensive

citations.quote: Explore each step of an executed query in the query profile.
Monitor individual or grouped queries that are executed by users in your account.
The Query History page lets you explore queries executed in your Snowflake account over the last 14 days.
